ei.title: How to Calm a Child's Tantrum
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: When a region of the emotional brain is overexcited due to frustration, sadness or any other intense emotion, the child is not able to contain their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find hard to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their rational part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an empathic reflection of the situation to defuse the intensity of the emotion. A spoken word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help soothe their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.

questions.passage: When a region of the emotional brain is (A)[overexcited / relaxed] due to frustration, sadness or any other intense emotion, the child is not able to contain their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find hard to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their (B)[physical / rational] part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an empathic reflection of the situation to defuse the intensity of the emotion. A spoken word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help (C)[worsen / soothe] their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정서적 뇌가 과도하게 흥분되면(overexcited), 아이는 이성적인(rational) 부분 밖에 있게 되며, 말은 아이가 감정을 진정시키도록(soothe) 돕는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① overexcited — rational — soothe — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② relaxed — rational — soothe (A 반대: 과흥분된→이완된)
❌ ③ overexcited — physical — soothe (B 변형: 이성적인→신체적인)
❌ ④ overexcited — rational — worsen (C 반대: 진정시키다→악화시키다)

questions.passage: When a region of the emotional brain is overexcited due to frustration, sadness or any other intense emotion, the child is not able to (A)[contain / express] their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find hard to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their rational part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an (B)[hostile / empathic] reflection of the situation to defuse the intensity of the emotion. A spoken word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help soothe their emotions, or at least give them the ability to (C)[ignore / listen] to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 아이는 기분을 억누를(contain) 수 없고, 공감적인(empathic) 반응이 최선의 전략이며, 아이가 부모의 말을 들을(listen) 수 있게 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① express — empathic — listen (A 반대: 억누르다→표출하다)
✅ ② contain — empathic — listen — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ contain — hostile — listen (B 반대: 공감적인→적대적인)
❌ ④ contain — empathic — ignore (C 반대: 듣다→무시하다)

questions.passage: When a region of the emotional brain is overexcited due to frustration, sadness or any other (A)[intense / mild] emotion, the child is not able to contain their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find (B)[easy / hard] to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their rational part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an empathic reflection of the situation to defuse the intensity of the emotion. A (C)[written / spoken] word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help soothe their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 강렬한(intense) 감정으로 흥분하면, 부모가 대처하기 힘든(hard) 말이 나오며, 한 마디의 말(spoken word)이 다리를 놓는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① mild — hard — spoken (A 반대: 강렬한→약한)
❌ ② intense — easy — spoken (B 반대: 힘든→쉬운)
✅ ③ intense — hard — spoken — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ intense — hard — written (C 반대: 말해진→글로 쓰인)

questions.passage: When a region of the emotional brain is ①<u>overexcited</u> due to frustration, sadness or any other intense emotion, the child is not able to contain their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find hard to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their ②<u>rational</u> part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an empathic reflection of the situation to ③<u>intensify</u> the intensity of the emotion. A spoken word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help ④<u>soothe</u> their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '강화하다(intensify)'가 아니라 '완화하다(defuse)'가 적절하다. 포옹과 공감으로 감정의 강도를 진정시킨다.
det.analysis:
① overexcited — 과도하게 흥분된, 원문 일치
② rational — 이성적인, 원문 일치
③ intensify — 원문은 defuse(완화하다) ←정답: 감정의 강도를 '진정'시키려는 맥락이므로 '강화하다'는 반대
④ soothe — 진정시키다, 원문 일치

questions.passage: When a region of the emotional brain is overexcited due to frustration, sadness or any other ①<u>intense</u> emotion, the child is not able to ②<u>release</u> their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find hard to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their rational part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an ③<u>empathic</u> reflection of the situation to defuse the intensity of the emotion. A ④<u>spoken</u> word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help soothe their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '표출하다(release)'가 아니라 '억누르다(contain)'가 적절하다. 흥분한 아이는 자기 기분을 억누르지 못한다.
det.analysis:
① intense — 강렬한, 원문 일치
② release — 원문은 contain(억누르다) ←정답: 아이가 기분을 '억누르지 못한다'는 맥락이므로 '표출하다'는 반대
③ empathic — 공감적인, 원문 일치
④ spoken — 말해진, 원문 일치
det.tip: not able to contain their mood(기분을 억누르지 못하다) ↔ release(표출하다)

A spoken word will form a bridge between the two worlds, allowing the child's rational brain to help soothe their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 좌절감, 슬픔 또는 다른 어떤 강렬한 감정(intense emotion)으로 인해 뇌가 흥분한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① physical exercise — 신체 운동 (뇌를 흥분시키는 감정이 아님)
❌ ② daily routine — 일상 (문맥과 무관)
✅ ③ intense emotion — 강렬한 감정 ←정답
❌ ④ financial problem — 재정 문제 (문맥과 무관)
det.tip: frustration, sadness or any other ____(좌절·슬픔과 나란한 것) → 강렬한 감정

questions.passage: When a region of the emotional brain is overexcited due to frustration, sadness or any other intense emotion, the child is not able to contain their mood. This is when the tantrums occur — situations in which the child closes in on themself and is not able to do what they are told — or comments are made which the parents find hard to deal with. Literally, the child is outside themselves, outside their rational part. To help them calm down, and to see reason, the best strategy is a hug and an empathic reflection of the situation to defuse the intensity of the emotion. A spoken word will form a bridge between __________, allowing the child's rational brain to help soothe their emotions, or at least give them the ability to listen to what their parents are saying.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 한 마디의 말은 (감정과 이성이라는) 두 세계(the two worlds) 사이에 다리를 놓는다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a single room — 한 개의 방 (문맥과 무관)
❌ ② the busy city — 분주한 도시 (문맥과 무관)
❌ ③ a new book — 새 책 (문맥과 무관)
✅ ④ the two worlds — 두 세계(감정과 이성) ←정답
det.tip: 감정적 뇌와 이성적 뇌 = 두 세계(the two worlds)를 잇는 다리
